scripts.install:all: npm --prefix wms_domain install && npm --prefix wms_admin install && npm --prefix wms_participant install && npm run install:backend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build:domain
scripts.dev:backend: npm run db:up && ./scripts/node22.sh npm run dev
